svg.title: MTG Deck Builder — Database Schema
svg.desc: Entity-relationship diagram of the SQLite database: decks, cards (Scryfall cache), and deck_card_entries (many-to-many junction).
svg.text: SQLite · 3 tables · decks ↔ cards via deck_card_entries (many-to-many)

g.text: • decks.id is AUTOINCREMENT · cards.id is the Scryfall card UUID (TEXT) · timestamps default to datetime(’now’)
• cards.colors / color_identity / card_faces_json are JSON-encoded TEXT columns (decoded to Python lists at read time)
• All columns are NOT NULL with defaults (section → ’main’, quantity → 1, format → ’casual’) · PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON
